被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了最新章节_第21章 青帝易容术第1页_被贬废丹房，我偷偷无敌了一朵青莲_热点小说网
> 第21章 青帝易容术（第1页）
陈长生回到废丹房后，居然没有发现丹老的身影，他找了一圈也没有找到，后来找到一道留言：陈长生，你我有缘，后会有期。
“为什么！”孤独空虚失落瞬间把陈长生包围，他感觉所有人都抛弃了自己。
半个月后，陈长生回收了大批的丹药，主要是聚气丹、辟谷丹、回元丹。
这些都是一品丹药，可惜的是他现在无法回收二品丹药，要不然的话那就发财了。
这段时间，陈长生一边炼丹，一边研究《炼器总纲》，又有了不少心得体会。
他本来打算把覆地印重新祭炼一番，奈何自己修为太低，无法实现。
“红云老祖，你是上古大能，该有些法术神通传授于我吧！”
陈长生暗暗和红云老祖沟通，这货乃是万年老妖，简直就是一座移动宝库，奈何这老家伙似乎是对自己还有些怨恨，平日里很少传自己东西。
“不是我不传授你神通，实在是你修为太低，等你筑基之后再说吧！”红云老祖不咸不淡的道，似乎是没有什么兴趣。
“红云老祖，我知你心中对我有怨恨，但你我现在乃一根绳子上的蚂蚱，我要是死了，在临死之前就引爆飞剑，咱俩一同下地狱。”
“哼！”红云老祖冷哼一声，气得不行，自己这是造了什么孽，招惹了这个小煞星。
红云老祖想了想，道：“虽然我没有什么神通传给你，但是有一个易容术可以传授于你，保证金丹期的修士也看不出你的真面目。”
陈长生大喜，“那还等什么，快！”
现在他最担心的就是自己的实力暴露，如果真有厉害的易容术，出门再也不怕被人给认出来了。
话音一落，红云老祖指尖弹射一点金光朝陈长生脑门射了过来。
陈长生也不怕他使坏，坦然接受，毕竟他要想使坏，恐怕早就下手了。
一段信息进入陈长生识海之中，是一段叫做《青帝易容术》的神通。
红云老祖有些不甘的哼道：“这青帝易容术乃是无上神通，等你修为高了容貌甚至可以做到千变万化，便宜你小子了！”

当年红云老祖能够从上古大战中苟活下来，有很大原因是他的容貌可以千变万化，让人很难对付。
两个时辰后，陈长生摇身一变变成了一名花季少女，他拿出铜镜照了照顿时面色一变，“这……怎么变成女人了？”
镜子里的自己花容月貌，嫣然是一名娇滴滴的仙子，就连声音都娇滴滴的。
“我怎么知道，肯定是你修为太低的缘故！”红云老祖暗地里偷笑，这《青帝易容术》他暗中做了手脚，让陈长生只能变成女人。
“这……这不行啊！”陈长生观察了一下自己，就连胸部都发生了变化，顿时想死的心都有了。
以后让自己顶着这俩大瓜到处乱晃？
不愧是《青帝易容术》，这易容的有些彻底啊！
接下来无论他如何施法，都只能变成这一个模样，不由无语的翻白眼。
肯定是这老鬼暗地里做了什么手脚。
红云老祖哈哈大笑，“小子，变成美女有什么不好的，这样不管你做什么，别人根本怀疑不到你头上来！”

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 21 The Qing Emperor's Disguise Technique Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 21 Qingdi’s Disguise (Page 1)
After Chen Changsheng returned to the Wasted Alchemy Room, he didn't find the figure of Elder Alchemy. He searched around and couldn't find it. Later, he found a message: Chen Changsheng, you and I are destined to see each other again.
"Why!" Chen Changsheng was instantly surrounded by loneliness, emptiness and loss. He felt that everyone had abandoned him.
Half a month later, Chen Changsheng recovered a large number of pills, mainly Qi Gathering Pill, Bigu Pill, and Huiyuan Pill.
These are first-grade elixirs. It is a pity that he cannot recycle the second-grade elixirs now, otherwise he would make a fortune.
During this period of time, Chen Changsheng was refining elixirs and studying the "General Guide to Refining Weapons", and gained a lot of insights.
He originally planned to re-refine the earth-shattering seal, but his cultivation level was too low to achieve it.
"Ancestor Hongyun, you are an ancient power, you should teach me some magical powers!"
Chen Changsheng secretly communicated with Ancestor Hongyun that this thing was a ten thousand-year-old demon and was simply a mobile treasure house. However, this old guy seemed to be a little resentful of himself and rarely passed on his own things.
"It's not that I won't teach you magical powers, it's just that your cultivation level is too low. Let's wait until you build the foundation!" Hongyun Ancestor said in a nonchalant manner, as if he had no interest.
"Ancestor Hongyun, I know you have resentment towards me in your heart, but you and I are just grasshoppers on a rope now. If I die, I will detonate the flying sword before I die, and we will go to hell together."
"Hmph!" Ancestor Hongyun snorted, extremely angry. What kind of evil had he done to provoke this little evil star?
Ancestor Hongyun thought for a while and said: "Although I don't have any magical powers to teach you, I can teach you a disguise technique that will ensure that even the monks at the Golden Core Stage will not be able to see your true face."
Chen Changsheng was overjoyed, "Then what are you waiting for? Hurry!"
What he is most worried about now is that his strength is exposed. If he really has powerful disguise skills, he will no longer be afraid of being recognized when he goes out.
As soon as he finished speaking, Patriarch Hongyun flicked a little golden light from his fingertips towards Chen Changsheng's forehead.
Chen Changsheng was not afraid of him causing harm and accepted it calmly. After all, if he wanted to cause harm, he would have done it long ago.
A piece of information entered Chen Changsheng's sea of ​​consciousness, and it was a piece of magical power called "The Art of Disguise".
Ancestor Hongyun hummed unwillingly: "The Qing Emperor's Disguise Technique is a supreme magical power. When you reach a higher level, your appearance can even change in thousands of ways. It will be an advantage for you, kid!"
The main reason why Patriarch Hongyun was able to survive the ancient war was that his appearance could be ever-changing, making it difficult for people to deal with him.
Two hours later, Chen Changsheng transformed into a young girl. He took out the bronze mirror and looked at it, and his expression suddenly changed, "Why...how did you become a woman?"
With her beautiful face in the mirror, Yanran looks like a delicate fairy, and even her voice is delicate.
"How do I know? It must be because your cultivation level is too low!" Ancestor Hongyun snickered secretly. He secretly manipulated the "Blue Emperor Disguise Technique" so that Chen Changsheng could only transform into a woman.
"This... this can't work!" Chen Changsheng observed himself, even his chest had changed, and he suddenly wanted to die.
Will you let yourself carry these two big melons around in the future?
It is worthy of being called the "Qing Emperor's Disguise Technique", this disguise is quite thorough!
No matter how he cast the spell next, it would only look like this, and he couldn't help but roll his eyes speechlessly.
This old ghost must have done something secretly.
Ancestor Hongyun laughed loudly, "Boy, what's wrong with becoming a beautiful woman? Then no matter what you do, others won't be able to suspect you at all!"
